name: Jet Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: an orange toy jet with lens eyes on its nose, swept wings and a roaring plume of red flame
entry: It roars across the sky trailing flames. It dives at flocks of bird Pokémon just to scatter them.
how: Use a Jet Turbine on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Hurricane in this form.
